arrangements.statePensionMessageEng: You will reach State Pension age on 27 July 2031. Your State Pension forecast is £94.80 a week.  You need to contribute National Insurance for another 7 years to reach your forecast. You have 8 years on your National Insurance record up to 5 April 2016. You usually need at least 10 years on your record to get any State Pension. Your forecast and State Pension age is not a guarantee and is based on the current law. Your forecast does not include any increase due to inflation. Your State Pension forecast may be different if there are any changes to your National Insurance record. To check your State Pension or National Insurance record at any time go to: www.gov.uk/check-state-pension
